rows.answer_text: Visakoivu Oy holds public liability insurance (toiminnan vastuuvakuutus) with cover of EUR 2,000,000, above the required minimum.
Visakoivu Oy's equity ratio in the most recently closed financial year, 2025, was 35.2%, above the required minimum.

Faults not resolved within the agreed target are escalated in stages: first to the responsible technician's team leader, then, if still unresolved, to the Visakoivu Oy service manager, who contacts the client directly with a revised plan and timeline. Persistent or safety-critical unresolved faults are escalated further to Visakoivu Oy's operations management.

Personnel working on site hold trade qualifications appropriate to their discipline: electricians and technicians operate under Visakoivu Oy's sahkourakointioikeudet class S1, refrigerant and HVAC work is carried out under our F-kaasuasetuksen mukainen patevyys, and all site staff are trained under our NMSB 75310:2018 occupational health and safety management system. Site supervisors hold LUSA-patevyys for the relevant trade.

Environmental management arrangements during the work follow Visakoivu Oy's NMSB 74210:2015 environmental management system, covering waste segregation, spill prevention and minimising disruption to ongoing logistics and warehouse operations, including work scheduling around the client's extended operating hours.

Visakoivu Oy's building automation team, 18 specialists in our rakennusautomaatio discipline, integrates with building automation systems over both BACnet and Modbus, the two protocols most commonly found in logistics and warehouse facilities, and will confirm compatibility with the specific system installed at each property during the technical survey.

Visakoivu Oy proposes a fixed annual price for scheduled maintenance, with corrective work outside the scheduled scope charged on a time-and-materials basis at agreed hourly rates, giving cost predictability for planned work while keeping unscheduled repairs transparent.
Visakoivu Oy proposes monthly invoicing, issued as a Finnish e-invoice (verkkolasku) itemised by property, in line with our standard billing practice.

Visakoivu Oy's quality management system is certified to NMSB 7310:2015. Work is carried out against documented procedures and task checklists, tested and signed off on completion, with non-conformities logged and tracked to resolution, and the system reviewed through periodic internal audits.
All prices in this tender are quoted in EUR, exclusive of VAT, as required.
This tender is submitted by e-mail to hankinta@rantatuotelogistiikka.example ahead of the deadline of 19 June 2026, 12:00 Helsinki time.

Lift maintenance is not a discipline in which Visakoivu Oy itself holds a statutory servicing qualification. For the lift maintenance element of this contract, Visakoivu Oy will engage an authorised lift maintenance subcontractor holding the certification required under Finnish lift safety regulation, managed as part of Visakoivu Oy's overall maintenance contract with Rantatuote Logistiikka Oy, so that statutory compliance for lift maintenance is fully assured without Visakoivu Oy overstating its own in-house qualification.

Periodic inspection of electrical installations is carried out by staff operating under Visakoivu Oy's sahkourakointioikeudet class S1, in line with the intervals required under Finnish electrical safety regulation, with inspection findings documented and reported to the client and any defects scheduled for correction.

This tender is signed by a person holding the right to sign on behalf of Visakoivu Oy, so a power of attorney is not required. Should a different signatory be used at a later stage, a power of attorney will be provided as required by Annex A.3.
Visakoivu Oy's registered business ID is 1876543-2.
The contact person handling the contract during its term will be named at contract signature; day-to-day contract management will be led by Visakoivu Oy's account manager for the client's region.
Visakoivu Oy encloses a current certificate confirming payment of its taxes (verovelkatodistus) together with this tender.

All certifications and evidence relied upon in this tender remain valid beyond the tender submission date of 19 June 2026; validity dates for each certification cited are given against the relevant requirement elsewhere in this tender, and Visakoivu Oy will confirm continued validity through contract start if requested.

general_sections.cover_letter: Visakoivu Oy is pleased to submit this tender for technical facility maintenance services for Rantatuote Logistiikka Oy's logistics and warehouse properties in the Jyvaskyla region. We are experienced in maintaining technical building systems for demanding operational environments and would welcome the opportunity to support a service model suited to extended operating hours.
general_sections.company_overview: Visakoivu Oy is a technical and property services company based in Jyvaskyla, offering HVAC, electrical, building automation and facilities maintenance to public and private clients across Central Finland, including logistics, industrial and commercial property portfolios.
